theme: An open day, the girls home in St. Pete.
greeting: The calendar is clear today, Dan, and the girls are with you and Mike in St. Petersburg — the day is yours to shape around them. A couple of travel-logistics threads have quietly gone overdue and are worth ten minutes.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: Open in your Family & Travel list since Sept 14. A refundable full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and sells out early; a refundable hold now costs nothing and takes the whole risk off the table.

needsAttention.title: Rebook the girls' passport appointment
needsAttention.detail: Flagged to reschedule after the Sept 20 return and now three days past due. The packet is essentially assembled, but the counter visit for all four girls still needs a new date.

schedule.title: Julia's birthday
schedule.detail: A birthday marker on your calendar

flagged.title: Board director connection request
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn invite from a Member of the Board at the NASBA Center for the Public Trust is waiting on your response.

flagged.title: AbeBooks password reset
flagged.detail: A Florida sign-in alert, then a confirmed password change and a book order — the sequence looks like you, no action needed if so.

flagged.title: Vinalhaven invite for Oct 3
flagged.detail: Marie's birthday at the Coke Bottle House, 5 PM on Oct 3, wants a yes or no if you're still on the island.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters, retail promos, and job digests — Uniqlo, HBO Max, Delta, the Press Herald, and a stack of LinkedIn public-policy role alerts.
inbox.clear: Nothing else is waiting on your reply tonight.

resolved.title: Agreed to moderate the ICGN Toronto panel
resolved.detail: Elizabeth Thomas confirmed on Sept 24 and will send speaker logistics and set up a pre-conference call — nothing owed from you for now.

recipe.title: White sweet potato soup with pickled scallions
recipe.why: Autumn cooking leans into the harvest — roots, squash, and slow heat as the days cool.

tasks.title: Call the dermatologist to book the girls' wart removal

acts.line: No meetings on the calendar — the morning is entirely open.
Still clear; a good window for the two overdue travel bookings.
Julia's birthday sits at 5, with the girls home for dinner.
